description: Na₂Sr₂Al₂PO₄F₉ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two O and four F atoms. There is one shorter (2.39 Å) and one longer (2.50 Å) Na-O bond length. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.58 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to one O and eight F atoms. The Na-O bond length is 2.87 Å. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.93 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to two O and seven F atoms. There is one shorter (2.67 Å) and one longer (2.69 Å) Sr-O bond length. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.76 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to two O and six F atoms. There is one shorter (2.63 Å) and one longer (2.72 Å) Sr-O bond length. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.63 Å. There are three inequivalent Al sites. In the first Al site, Al is bonded to one O and five F atoms to form AlOF₅ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The Al-O bond length is 1.87 Å. There are a spread of Al-F bond distances ranging from 1.82-1.85 Å. In the second Al site, Al is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form AlO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. Both Al-O bond lengths are 1.89 Å. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.85 Å) Al-F bond lengths. In the third Al site, Al is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form AlO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. Both Al-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. There are two shorter (1.83 Å) and two longer (1.86 Å) Al-F bond lengths. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three AlOF₅ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.56 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Sr, and one P atom to form distorted ONaSr₂P tetrahedra that share corners with four FNaSr₂Al tetrahedra. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Sr, one Al, and one P atom. There are nine inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to one Na, two Sr, and one Al atom to form distorted FNaSr₂Al tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaSr₂P tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent FNa₂SrAl tetrahedra. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom to form distorted FNa₂SrAl tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaSr₂P tetrahedra and corners with three FNaSr₂Al tetrahedra. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to two Sr and one Al atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Al atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Sr, and one Al atom.
